posts.cooked:
Have they given any indication of about when they will be putting out the full book?
My group has played through the first two adventures and have had a lot of fun, but that means we are going to be done in a month and will be wanting more, ready to make our own characters. So hoping we don’t have to wait all that long to get the book to do so.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: We are definitely on track for a Q2 KS for the RPG. Final development, writing, layout/design, etc is all coming along very well! Over the course of crafting the Starter Kit, we discovered and ironed out a lot of the kids of pitfalls that can happen with RPG development. We've also gotten a ton of awesome feedback since the Starter Kit was released, which we are considering and incorporating into the Core Rulebook.
